in_english.name: Jivan
in_english.meaning: A variant of the name Ilyasin or Ilyas, meaning 'prophet' or 'ascetic' in Arabic.
in_english.long_meaning: The name Jivan is derived from the Arabic root  ي-س-ن (Y-S-N), meaning 'prophet' or 'ascetic.' In Islamic tradition, the name Ilyas is associated with the Prophet Elijah, who was a righteous and pious individual. The name Jivan conveys a sense of spirituality, piety, and righteousness. In Arabic, the name is also associated with the word  جِن (Jin), meaning 'spirit' or 'angel.' The name Jivan is also found in Persian and Urdu cultures, where it is written as  جِوان (Jivan), meaning 'living' or 'spirited.' In modern times, the name Jivan has gained popularity in various Muslim cultures, including Indian and Pakistani communities.
